what: Where each tracked game sat on China's iPhone App Store top-grossing chart (all apps), day by day.
source: Qimai (七麦数据) rank trend — App Store China, iPhone, overall top-grossing chart (总榜·畅销), 200 deep
note: games[tag][date] = the game's rank at the END of that day; best[tag][date] = the best rank it reached at any point that day. A date inside covered[tag] with no entry means the game was off the chart (below #200) — a real reading, not a gap. A date outside covered[tag] has not been read. days lists every date read for at least one game.
